rationale: hxor_packer 0.1 gates all unpacking on GetTickCount around Sleep(500) being <= 550 ms (unpacker/src/antiDefense.cpp runtimeDelay; main.cpp 'if(!isAll())'). MEASURED offsets, read out of guest memory via the plugin's file_io_payload logging: shift=2 -> 578/672/734 (detected), shift=1 sleep=off -> 593 (detected), shift=0 sleep=on -> 547 (passed, 3 ms margin), shift=0 sleep=off -> 515 (passed, 35 ms margin). sleep=off is chosen for the margin. At shift=0 a Sleep(500) needs ~500M retired instructions, so any run needs --host-idle-seconds >= 1800 or the host idle detector kills it mid-sleep.
